## Design

### 2026-11-07: Nov 6 - switching and planning

**4h**

Nov 6 - switching and planning
(lack of time, so writing on a different day)

I recently realized that I was not going to be able to do a devboard, and what's more, I didn't want to. So I decided to switch my project to a CAD project, and after much thinking, I came upon a tabletop mini-golf course. Then I got started researching and planning.

 First, I looked at some tabletop mini-golf games, then on to 3d printed ones, where I got the modular idea from.
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/75fdc803ea00c4e58202d2b5a8ad5212b29abb81a647f46e47037ee04909cb21.png)

![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/67f733310976530549e28cf4d782997ff5fd1cc6761e57e93726f07f4c55a53e.png)

Then I got to work working on an outline for the track. Here's a reference photo i used for the first bit

![LNAlQF9jk35qUIMLjal91O5miXqnwfq7IxmvwUyQJdC6gFxHJkJ-xK3WaqJybOItPuYBj1hHyv_P7ELk](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/7463a4a6f6a7515176cd3323d9dfe1b0e6b2afd1da9f25a088a9b467c6fe9c35.jpg)

### 2026-11-07: Nov 7 - beginning CAD

**7h**

Nov 7 - beginning CAD

After doing some scale checking, I made the preliminary level and ball. The ball will have a 6mm diameter.
![](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/2c9a3b4897e3b4b44db70095f50bfc9cfb6de3b654cad0c3cd503d7aa76b643e.png)

Then I made the walls, which have a height of 5 mm, and then i made the club. i spent a lot of time scaling and making sure it all worked
![Screenshot 6](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/4fa4928493a82c7bb47bae2d9b7cf863975cc4093fa48ae137082cd32ff8d571.png)

Then I moved on to making the hole. I decided it should go through.
![Screenshot 2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/bf0931dd2cba7575153d5503d95f3f1f7de75f2b0fffab6507903de14f6b3ed8.png)

then i did the other side of the build's walls.
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/8bd829b32448ba4d4e59caa96ad2707675f7f483004d169c04a98586f99587d8.png)

Then I made the holes to mount the supports so it can stand up
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/18196209b79e3689fa1267a3f20d1d8ed05ebad19fb9655a6a8abacb314fcfde.png)

Once that was done, I measured so I knew it would be level.
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/fe1bfed820557673edf48fc2c33670ec96c2c9d488822253bd4ccc3d39f5e2de.png)

Then I repeated the structure support again on the other side. it was faster this time because I already had a lot of the dimensions i needed.
![Screenshot ](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/c3e43d4e7ef7449ad84c28cfc42e1e15e1371a064161adc41a61e2493ea1e34f.png)

Next: modular component and addons

TL;DR: finished basic CAD design.
